description: Desarrollo de un proyecto tecnológico e innovador como parte del hackathon global NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Este evento reúne a tecnólogos, científicos, diseñadores y entusiastas del espacio para crear soluciones impulsadas por datos abiertos de la NASA, abordando desafíos críticos para la exploración espacial y la sostenibilidad en la Tierra.
summary:
MISSION ARCHITECT is an interactive web-based simulator that lets users design, configure, and fly complete space missions while experiencing real engineering trade-offs.

Players select a destination (Moon, Venus, Mars, Bennu or Europa), mission type, crew, launcher, propulsion, power, communications and scientific instruments under a limited budget. The system calculates mass, delta-v, power generation, data rate and risk using simplified but realistic orbital mechanics. During the flight, players face critical decision points that affect the final outcome. The project also includes adjustable difficulty, shareable design codes, and a detailed mission report.

It directly addresses the “Space Mission Design Game” challenge by turning complex mission design decisions into an engaging, educational and replayable experience.
details:
Mission Architect is an interactive web-based space simulator and orbital design platform created to bridge the gap between conceptual aerospace engineering and real-time mission execution. What it does & How it works:

The application allows users, students, and mission planners to design, simulate, and visualize spacecraft trajectories in real time. It integrates physical astrodynamics principles—including Keplerian orbital propagation, N-body gravitational modeling, atmospheric drag, solar radiation pressure, and Earth's zonal harmonics (J2)—to calculate Delta-V budgets and simulate multi-spacecraft constellation coordination. Tools & Coding Languages:

Built as a lightweight, browser-accessible simulator using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript for physics calculations, telemetry rendering, and interactive 3D orbital visualization. Creativity, Benefits & Impact:

By turning complex orbital mechanics into an intuitive, visual simulation environment, Mission Architect lowers the barrier to entry for space mission design—accelerating prototyping from concept to validation while empowering students, educators, and aspiring aerospace engineers
